dedupe_keys.name: parlamento de canarias port and maritime datasets

description: Parlamento de Canarias: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Parlamento de Canarias. Coverage: Parlamento de Canarias. The listing groups 25 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Resultados electorales 2023 - Fuerteventura - Puerto del Rosario; Resultados electorales 2007 - Fuerteventura - Puerto del Rosario; Resultados electorales 2023 - Autonómica - Puerto del Rosario; Resultados electorales 2015 - Fuerteventura - Puerto del Rosario. Formats seen: CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/odc-pddl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
